sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Gorges du Tarn is a limestone sport climbing gorge in southeast France.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: PlanetMountain supports 400 limestone routes over five sectors; the legacy packet adds pockets, crimps, overhangs, rivers and pine forest.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: Legacy evidence points especially to sport climbers comfortable with longer routes and 7th-grade climbing, while still noting a broader grade mix.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: Route count is sourced externally; the grade wording is kept as legacy prose rather than a normalized numeric range.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: The legacy packet supports spring and autumn, and warns that summers are too hot and winters too cold.

sections.heading: Transport and access

sections.heading: Rest days
